markers.name: Seaford Volcano
markers.note: Dormant volcano. Height: 3364m.

markers.name: Chedlyndenead Hot Springs
markers.note: A geothermal springs with naturally heated water that provide relaxation and medicinal benefits. Average temperature is 36°C.

markers.note: This legendary water source is whispered about in ancient tales and believed to possess mystical properties. The spring emanates crystal-clear water, shimmering with an otherworldly iridescence that sparkles even in the dimmest light.

markers.name: Gilmerius Monster
markers.note: Whispers say a relic monster of 14 m long inhabits Gilmerius Lake. Truth or lie, folks are afraid to fish in the lake.

markers.name: Utheshe Troll
markers.note: Locals speak of a terrifying Troll who inhabits Utheshe hills and doesn't mind human flesh.

markers.name: Stotleton Beast
markers.note: Journeying folk speak of a golden Beast who inhabits Stotleton hills and steals cattle at night.

markers.name: Tritur Forest
markers.note: A forest sacred to local Trow Idols.

markers.name: Westckewent Monument
markers.note:
An ancient monument. It has an inscription, but no one can translate it:
የአበለለገጰፐመጸነገፈየሐኀበሐፀቀኀሠአፀ ኀሰፈሐወነጰ ወወደዐመነ ኀወለበጸፀየፐፀሐ አፈጰገረከሐፈዘሠበወፐለወ ሠዐ ወጸዘአ ጠነሰ ሠ

markers.name: Stotfield Pillar
markers.note:
An ancient pillar. It has an inscription, but no one can translate it:
በደ ፈሠጸከለረ ከተቀሀደበሠዐሐገፀደደሰበነነቀዐቀወሀሐጰሀጠቀ ዐተደ

markers.name: Brampseamer Effigy
markers.note:
An ancient effigy. It has an inscription, but no one can translate it:
ሀ ወየደፐበረነጸዘገተሠፐገሐሠጰፀፐፀጸሀጰደከዐሀነጸዐሠገወሠ ደቀ ሰከየጰጸፐገቀ ዘነወረረፀደፈፀየደመገፈጰአነ ተገሐጸ ዐ
